Title: Azure Databricks Unit pre-purchase plan is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Databricks Unit pre-purchase plan is now available, helping to make Azure the most cost-effective cloud for your workloads. This new pricing option saves you up to 37 percent compared to pay-as-you-go pricing by pre-paying for your Azure Databricks Units for a one-year or three-year term. Improve your budget forecasting with a single upfront payment, which makes it easy to calculate your investments. All Azure Databricks SKUs are eligible for the Azure Databricks Units pre-purchase plan.

Learn more at the Azure blog.
